compatibility: Memory sources use unsigned address spaces; stream APIs use signed local positions.

coordinates.fieldOffset: nonnegative byte count relative to containing record
coordinates.bitOffset: low-bit index in selected integer storage

matrix.read: UnionValue with raw storage and all interpretations
matrix.serialize: UnionValue named after the union: FromRaw or a read value copies exact bytes, FromMember encodes one member over zeroes
matrix.plan-update: selected field preserves unrelated bytes; whole union from FromMember clears unused storage

matrix.read: PrimitiveArray<T> for numeric or bool scalar elements, otherwise List<object?>
raw byte[] of the declared size

failureRules: commit failure identifies completed prefix and uncertain fragment
MemoryAccessException is a CStructReadException: ReadLimitExceeded for BudgetExceeded, otherwise ReadFailed
source coordinates are null when a failure has no source address
path errors are CStructPathException, value errors CStructWriteException, definition and metadata errors CStructLayoutException
parameter-contract violations, read-only sources, and cancellation keep .NET exception types

metadata.btf: v1 reachable value types and split tables; no ELF extraction
metadata.isf: 6.2.0 reachable type subset; no profile matching or relocations
